rationale: The React layout prop applier resolved width and height only for numeric and simple string forms, so an authored calc() dimension was silently dropped and the element fell back to its content size instead of the size the design asked for -- a whole class of imported layouts sized wrong with no error anywhere. The fix resolves calc() through the same dimension path every other layout prop already uses, so percentage, pixel and calc forms agree. render-assets-and-backends is crossed by packages/pulp-react only: prop-applier-layout.ts carries the resolution change and prop-applier-dimensions-calc.test.ts adds coverage that fails when an unresolved form is dropped again. No renderer, backend, font, asset or Skia pin changes; no fixture, snapshot or threshold moves, and no existing detector's expectations change. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
